modelNotes: Assists Board 1.0 uses season assists, last 5 assists, last 10 assists, expected minutes, minutes confidence, usage, position role, and recent assist trend.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Williams (foot) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Raptors, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Williams has missed the past two games for the Lakers, and with Sunday's game being the first of a back-to-back, he might need to spend one more game on the inactive list. If he's out again, Quentin Grimes will help fill his minutes.

injury.shortComment: Santos (knee) is probable for Sunday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Santos is expected to continue to push through the pain with his knee issue. He's averaging 7.8 points, 4.2 rebounds and 1.4 assists per game this season.

injury.shortComment: Nesmith (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against Brooklyn.
injury.detail: Nesmith didn't play in the 123-120 loss to New Orleans on Opening Night but has played in each of the Pacers' last five contests. Although he could see limited action while he continues to work his way back from the left hamstring strain, he will likely be out there Sunday, barring a setback.

injury.shortComment: Toppin (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Nets.
injury.detail: Toppin sat out Friday's 145-125 loss to the Heat due to the back issue, and with Sunday's game being the first of a back-to-back set, he may need to spend at least one more game on the sidelines. If he's out, Jarace Walker and Kobe Brown would likely see a bump in minutes.

injury.shortComment: Robinson (rest) is questionable for Sunday's game in Orlando, Jay King of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Sunday's game will be the first of a back-to-back set, so Robinson might get scheduled for a maintenance day. If he's forced to the sidelines, Neemias Queta would likely start, and Luka Garza could see a bump in minutes.
